prompt: I need to create a comprehensive brand guide presentation for our new client 'TechFlow Dynamics' - they're a B2B SaaS company focusing on workflow automation. The presentation should have 12 slides covering: title slide, company overview, brand essence, color palette, typography, logo usage, imagery style, tone of voice, do's and don'ts, applications, contact info, and thank you slide. Please create this presentation and apply an appropriate theme that matches their tech-forward but professional identity. If none of the existing themes work perfectly, create a custom one that captures their innovative yet trustworthy brand positioning.
